sentences.text:
2. The short facts leading to filing of present Revision Application are that respondent  No.1Shri Raval, while serving as Food Inspector with Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, 
purchased from the present applicant 750ml of cow milk on 24.06.1992 at 9.00AM  o n p a y m e n t o f a n a m o u n t o f R s . 6 f o r g e t t i n g t h e s a m e  a n a l y z e d a n d o n a n a l y s i s b y S h r i K . A .
P a t e l , P u b l i c  A n a l y s t , i t w a s f o u n d t h a t m i l k f a t i n t h e s a m p l e o f

cow milk was 2.9% instead of 3.5%, while milk solid non fat was found to be 8.96% which  w a s m o r e t h a n p r e s c r i b e d s t a n d a r d o f 8 . 5 % . C o n s e q u e n t l y t h e r e f o r e , 
a complaint came to be lodged by respondent No.1Shri RavalFood Inspector.
After trial and  h e a r i n g , t h e p r e s e n t a p p l i c a n t c a m e t o b e c o n v i c t e d b y l e a r n e d  Magistrate.
Being aggrieved by the said judgment and order of conviction
, the applicant  preferred an appeal before learned Additional City Sessions Judge, in which, the sentence  came to be reduced from 3 years to 1 year.
Both these judgments are precisely  challenged by way of preferring the present Revision Application.
3 . I n t h e R e v i s i o n A p p l i c a t i o n , i t i s c o n t e n d e d
that the procedure adopted while inspecting the shop as well as procedure adopted for  collecting the sample were not in accordance with the rules and the procedure laid down.
It  was further contended that the learned Trial Court as well as First Appellate  Court failed to appreciate the evidence on record and wrongly convicted the applicant as such.
R /CR.RA/179/1999 JUDGMENT 4 .

T h i s C o u r t h a s h e a r d l e a r n e d a d v o c a t e M r . D . K . 
Modi for the applicant, learned advocate Mr. Satyam Chhaya for respondent No.1 and learned  Additional Public Prosecutor Mr. K. P. Raval for respondent No.2.

4.1 At the outset, learned advocate for the applicant submitted that Shri K. A. Patel, 
Public Analyst was not empowered to analyze the sample as at the relevant time, he was not  appointed for the jurisdiction of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation.

He further  contended that the said issue has been considered at length by this Court while delivering  judgment in case of B. H. Patel, Food Inspector vs. Laxmandas Sevaram & Ors. reported in  2017(2) GLR 1709 and present case is also covered in view of said judgment.

entities.text: B. H. Patel, Food Inspector vs. Laxmandas Sevaram & Ors. reported in  2017(2) GLR 1709
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. In B. H. Patel, Food Inspector (supra), this Court observed and held as under:
"Mr. Modi has drawn attention of this Court to the report at page 151 produced vide Exh.16  which is alleged to have been given by Public Analyst Mr.K.A.Patel on 20.12.1991  whereas the sample was sent on 26.11.1991.

Mr.Modi also drawn attention of  this Court to the notification issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department, 
Government of Gujarat dated 24.9.1991 in exercise of the powers conferred by section 8 Vishnubhai Ranchhodbhai Patel vs A D Raval on 25 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110084820/
2  of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (the Act for short) amending

entities.text:
Health and Family Welfare Department, 
Government of Gujarat
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Vishnubhai Ranchhodbhai Patel vs A D Raval
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: the  notification of the Health and Family Welfare Department dated 12.5.1988. In the  schedule appended to the said notification, for the entry at serial No.7, the said entry has  been substituted.

In his submission, therefore, in view of the evidence on record, it  cannot be said that the learned trial Judge has committed any error in  passing the impugned order acquitting the accused, and therefore, the present appeal deserves  to be R/CR.RA/179/1999 JUDGMENT dismissed.

7. This Court has heard Ms.Jhaveri, learned advocate for the appellant, Mr.D.K.Modi, 
l e a r n e d a d v o c a t e f o r t h e r e s p o n d e n t s a c c u s e d a n d  Mr.L.B.Dabhi, learned APP for the respondent State. 
8.
This Court has minutely gone through the impugned judgment rendered by learned  trial Court as well as the evidence on record in the nature of paper book.
Ms.Jhaveri, learned  advocate for the appellant has drawn attention of this Court that
vide entry No.7 of the notification dated 1.8.1991
, Mr.K.A.Patel, Junior Scientific Assistant was  empowered and assigned the areas within the limits of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation.

It  is the contention of Ms.Jhaveri that Mr.K.A.Patel was authorized officer as per the  notification dated 1.8.1991, whereas it is the contention of Mr.Modi that in view of the  amended notification dated 24.9.1991, Mr.K.A.Patel was no more authorized as  in his place Mr.B.R.Desai was substituted for whole of the State of Gujarat.

On perusal of  both the aforesaid notifications, the contention raised by Mr.Modi appears to be acceptable  and the same was also accepted by learned trial Court as on the date of receiving the sample  and issuance of report on 20.12.1991, Mr.K.A.Patel was no more authorized as  Public Analyst for the areas within the limits of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation."

6. At the time of hearing of this revision application, learned advocate Mr. Satyam  C h h a y a f o r t h e A h m e d a b a d M u n i c i p a l C o r p o r a t i o n c o u l d n o t p o i n t  o u t a n y c o n t r a r y n o t i f i c a t i o n i n d i c a t i n g t h a t S h r i K .
A. Patel was authorized to analyze the sample drawn within the limits of jurisdiction of  Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation.

7 . I n v i e w o f a b o v e f a c t u a l s c e n a r i o e m e r g i n g o u t  from the record & proceedings, it appears that at the relevant time i.e. on 24.06.1992, Shri K.
 A. Patel was not appointed as Public Analyst authorizing him to analyze the sample within  the jurisdiction of R/CR.RA/179/1999 JUDGMENT Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation and  consequently therefore, for want of authorization on part of Shri K. A. Patel, Public Analyst, 
the entire procedure gets vitiated and based upon such report of the Public Analyst, 
no conviction could have been recorded as such and the same deserves to be quashed  and set aside.
8.
For the reasons recorded above, the present Criminal Revision Application is allowed.
